strings.zh: 小豪『那……那个是梦幻！{NEWLINE}传说中的精灵梦幻！{CLEAR}哇,只在图画书上见过的精灵{CLEAR}居然被我遇到了。
strings.en: Goh: Th-that’s Mew! The legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon Mew!{SCROLL}Whoa, I’ve only ever seen it in picture{NEWLINE}books, and I actually found one!
strings.notes: Route 27 / Tohjo Falls scene: Goh and Eusine chase a ‘Suicune’ that is really Mew in disguise (#0–24, #37–43; #11/#12 and #17–19 are alternative reveal lines). #25–31 guard and musician NPCs, #32–36 Route 27 checkpoint.

strings.zh: 梦幻『Meee——ew！
strings.en: Mew: Meee-ew!

strings.zh: 这里是东城洞穴{NEWLINE}关东与城都的交界处
strings.en: Tohjo Falls{SCROLL}The Link between{NEWLINE}Kanto and Johto

strings.zh: 西　若叶镇{NEWLINE}东　２６号道路
strings.en: West to New Bark Town{NEWLINE}East to Rt. 26

strings.zh: 小豪『精灵球,Go！
strings.en: Goh: Poké Ball, go!

strings.zh: 米那君『等一下！
strings.en: Eusine: Wait!

strings.zh: 梦幻『Meee——ew！{SCROLL}梦幻蹭了蹭你。
strings.en: Mew: Meee-ew!{SCROLL}Mew nuzzled you.

strings.zh: 小豪『你干什么！干嘛妨碍我抓精灵！
strings.en: Goh: What are you doing?! Why are you{NEWLINE}getting in the way of my catch?!

strings.zh: 米那君『对不起啊,{NEWLINE}这只水君是我先发现的,{CLEAR}它是我长久以来一直追寻{CLEAR}并希望收服的精灵。{CLEAR}所以收服水君应该是由我先来吧。
strings.en: Eusine: I’m sorry, but I found this{NEWLINE}Suicune first.{SCROLL}It’s the Pokémon I’ve spent so long{NEWLINE}chasing and hoping to catch.{SCROLL}So I should get the first chance to{NEWLINE}catch it.

strings.zh: 小豪『哼,这种事哪有什么先来后到,{NEWLINE}当然是手快有手慢无。{CLEAR}你如果非要碍事的话,{CLEAR}就别怪我收拾你了。
strings.en: Goh: Hmph. There’s no ‘first come, first{NEWLINE}served’ here.{SCROLL}Whoever’s quickest gets it.{SCROLL}If you insist on getting in my way, don’t{NEWLINE}blame me when I take you down.

strings.zh: 米那君『真是个不明事理的人,{NEWLINE}如果你非要比划比划,{CLEAR}那我就只好奉陪了。
strings.en: Eusine: What an unreasonable person.{SCROLL}If you insist on a fight, I’ll have to{NEWLINE}oblige.

strings.zh: 米那君『啊……原来如此！{NEWLINE}这是拥有变形能力的梦幻,{CLEAR}刚才只是梦幻变成的水君,{CLEAR}而非真正的水君。
strings.en: Eusine: Ah... I see! This is Mew, which{NEWLINE}can transform.{SCROLL}That was just Mew in the form of{NEWLINE}Suicune, not the real Suicune.

strings.zh: 小豪『啊哈哈哈哈哈！{NEWLINE}这是传说中的梦幻！{CLEAR}这可比什么水君珍稀多了,{CLEAR}我的运气真是太好了！
strings.en: Goh: Ah-hah-hah-hah-hah! It’s the{NEWLINE}legendary Mew!{SCROLL}That’s way rarer than some Suicune. I’m{NEWLINE}so lucky!

strings.zh: 小豪『喂！我说……
strings.en: Goh: Hey! I said...

strings.zh: 小豪『梦幻你给我……
strings.en: Goh: Mew, you’d better...
strings.notes: | RV052: addition: ‘get back’ invented; 你给我…… leads into #20 ‘乖乖到球里来’

strings.zh: 水君『Suiiii——cun！
strings.en: Suicune: Suiiii-cune!
{VAR:0103:0}: This Pokémon is...?

strings.zh: 米那君『天啊！真的是水君！{NEWLINE}我还以为是那些目击者瞎说的呢。
strings.en: Eusine: Oh my! It really is Suicune!{SCROLL}I thought the witnesses were just{NEWLINE}making things up.

strings.zh: 米那君『但是……不可能啊……{NEWLINE}根据我的调查,{CLEAR}水君应该还在烧焦塔的封印中,{CLEAR}怎么会出现在这里呢？
strings.en: Eusine: But... that’s impossible...{SCROLL}My research says Suicune should still be{NEWLINE}sealed in the Burned Tower.{SCROLL}What’s it doing here?

strings.zh: 小豪『哇哦！{NEWLINE}这是画册上的传说精灵水君！{CLEAR}还没到城都地区就遇到这种精灵{CLEAR}真是太幸运了！
strings.en: Goh: Whoa! It’s Suicune, the legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon from the picture books!{SCROLL}Running into a Pokémon like this before{NEWLINE}I’ve even reached Johto...{SCROLL}Talk about lucky!

strings.zh: 小豪『乖乖到球里来！
strings.en: Goh: Get in the ball like a good little{NEWLINE}Pokémon!

strings.zh: 要阻止小豪捕捉梦幻吗？
strings.en: Stop Goh from catching Mew?

strings.zh: 小豪『切,真是个麻烦的家伙。{NEWLINE}不过既然让我遇到了,{CLEAR}我就绝对不会放过你！
strings.en: Goh: Tch, what a pain.{SCROLL}But now that I’ve found it, there’s no{NEWLINE}way I’m letting you get away!

strings.zh: 米那君『果然不是真的水君啊。{NEWLINE}看来要想见到水君,{CLEAR}还是得想办法解开烧焦塔的封印才行。
strings.en: Eusine: So it wasn’t the real Suicune{NEWLINE}after all.{SCROLL}Looks like if I want to meet Suicune,{NEWLINE}I’ll have to find a way to break the{CLEAR}Burned Tower’s seal.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你没有看出来吗？{NEWLINE}这只梦幻根本就不喜欢你。{CLEAR}你还是不要追着收服它了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Can’t you see? This Mew{NEWLINE}doesn’t like you at all. Stop chasing it.

strings.zh: 从这里向西不远就是若叶镇,{NEWLINE}向东穿过东城洞穴则可以到达关东。{CLEAR}如此重要的交通要道,{CLEAR}必须要24小时值守才行。
strings.en: Not far west of here is New Bark Town,{NEWLINE}and east through Tohjo Falls is Kanto.{SCROLL}A route this important has to be{NEWLINE}guarded around the clock.

strings.zh: 你来这里是想听我演奏歌曲吗？
strings.en: Are you here to hear me play a song?

strings.zh: 那就是想跟我对战咯？{NEWLINE}没问题,我满足你！
strings.en: Then you want a battle? Sure, I’ll give{NEWLINE}you one!

strings.zh: 嘿！你虽然很有战斗天赋,{NEWLINE}但却毫无乐感。{CLEAR}这个叮咚作响的铃铛送给你,{CLEAR}帮你提升一下乐感吧。
strings.en: Hey! You’ve got a talent for battling,{NEWLINE}but no ear for music at all.{SCROLL}Take this jingly bell to help you improve{NEWLINE}your sense of music.

strings.zh: 空。

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,请听我演奏的这动人旋律！
strings.en: Heh heh, listen to the moving melody I’m{NEWLINE}about to play!

strings.zh: 怎么样？这曲子的感觉还不错吧？
strings.en: Well? Not a bad tune, huh?

strings.zh: 你好,这里是27号路检查哨,{NEWLINE}因为最近城都地区传出了{CLEAR}火箭队开始活跃的消息。{CLEAR}所以出于治安考虑,通过此地的行人{CLEAR}需要出示身份证件进行登记,{CLEAR}请你配合一下。
strings.en: Hello, this is the Route 27 checkpoint.{SCROLL}Word has come out of Johto recently{NEWLINE}that Team Rocket is active again.{SCROLL}So for security, everyone passing{NEWLINE}through must show ID and register.{SCROLL}Your cooperation, please.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好的,这是我的训练师卡片。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sure, here’s my Trainer Card.

strings.zh: 我看看啊……联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}……
strings.en: Let’s see... League Champion {VAR:0103:0}...

strings.zh: 联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{CLEAR}天啊,我竟然在这里遇到了冠军大人。{SCROLL}虽然我看了您的每一场对战转播,{NEWLINE}但是现实中看真人与电视里看画面{CLEAR}还是不太一样的,{CLEAR}所以我没能第一时间认出您,{CLEAR}实在是非常抱歉。
strings.en: League Champion {VAR:0103:0}! You’re League{NEWLINE}Champion {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}Oh my gosh, I can’t believe I’ve met the{NEWLINE}Champion here.{SCROLL}I’ve watched every one of your matches{NEWLINE}on TV, but seeing you in real life isn’t{CLEAR}quite the same as seeing you on screen,{CLEAR}so I didn’t recognize you right away.{SCROLL}I’m truly sorry.

strings.zh: 我已经为您做好了登记,{NEWLINE}您可以随意通过此地了。
strings.en: I’ve finished registering you. You’re{NEWLINE}free to pass through here anytime.

strings.zh: 风速狗『Ar——can！
strings.en: Arcanine: Ar-can!

strings.zh: 梦幻『Meee——ew！
strings.en: Mew: Meee-ew!

strings.zh: 小豪『少跑出来碍事！{NEWLINE}梦幻是我的,{CLEAR}谁也不能阻止我抓住它！
strings.en: Goh: Quit getting in the way!{SCROLL}Mew is mine. Nobody’s going to stop me{NEWLINE}from catching it!

strings.zh: 小豪『真是老天没长眼,{NEWLINE}居然让你这种人打败我。{CLEAR}不过我不会放弃的,{CLEAR}总有一天我会把你打败！
strings.en: Goh: Heaven must be blind to let{NEWLINE}someone like you beat me.{SCROLL}But I won’t give up. Someday I’ll beat{NEWLINE}you!

strings.zh: 小豪『切,既然让我遇到梦幻了,{NEWLINE}我就非抓到它不可！
strings.en: Goh: Tch, now that I’ve found Mew, I’m{NEWLINE}catching it no matter what!

strings.zh: 小豪『那么你现在{NEWLINE}就乖乖成为我的手下吧！
strings.en: Goh: So be a good little Pokémon and{NEWLINE}become my underling!
